sections.title: Common Questions
sections.subtitle: Clear, straightforward details about our cleaning process and policies.

items.question: What is included in your one-hour service?
items.answer: Our expedited one-hour service applies to standard dry cleaning items dropped off before 2:00 PM. Complex stains, heavy coats, or delicate fabrics requiring specialized care may need standard processing time.

items.question: Do you clean household textiles or bedding?
items.answer: Yes, we professionally clean duvets, blankets, and select drapery. We ask that you allow a 48-hour turnaround for these oversized household items to ensure proper drying and pressing.

items.question: Are your cleaning methods safe for vintage clothing?
items.answer: Absolutely. We assess every vintage or fragile piece individually to determine the safest cleaning method, whether that requires specialized dry cleaning or meticulous hand washing.

items.question: Do you offer alterations or tailoring?
items.answer: We handle minor repairs like button replacements and simple seam fixes in-house. For complex alterations, we partner with trusted local tailors to ensure your garments fit perfectly.
